items.title: Fright Or Flight
items.creator: Robot Pantaloons
items.description:
Be prepared to get scared! These frightening skins will send chills down your spine...

- 1 Free Skin!
- 10 Frighteningly Horrifying Skins
- By RobotPantaloons

items.title: Cupcake Mobs
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
Who likes to party? We do, especially when cupcakes are involved! Alex and Steve are celebrating the best way they know how, by turning those scary and menacing creatures into a colorful treat, with icing, sprinkles and a whole lot of sweet fun! Don't delay, stop by the party and get your cupcake today!
Includes 12 sugary skins - 2 free!

items.title: Ultra Modern Texture Pack
items.creator: Cyclone
items.description:
Bring new, smooth vibes to your Minecraft with the Ultra Modern texture pack. Perfectly suited for modern furniture and dreamy city homes.
+ modern textures for your own world
+ smoothly refined HD 32x32 textures
+ vanilla friendly
items.changelog:
Tiny Takeover update!
Now fully compatible with the latest Minecraft version

items.title: CLASSICS
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
Grab one of our classic teen skins! Any of these outfits will go perfect with your next survival world!

+ 10 classic teen skin styles

items.title: Cute Animal Hats
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
These cute animal hats are super fun to wear! Is your favorite the panda or the piggy one? Pssst, there are lots of adorable animals to pick from! Grab a cool skin along with your friends.

- 8 AWESOME animal hat skins
- Licensed by UniDesigns and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Gamers Skin Pack
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Are you ready to become a professional gamer? Pursue your dream and gear up your headphones, creeper shirts, and the coolest hoodies!

- 12 skins included!
- Perfect for roleplay
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Levelatics.

items.title: Highschool Madness
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
It's the autumn season, and school started again! What an excellent way to start your days. Jump into your special outfits and try to catch the bus. Don't know what to wear? Don't worry; we have you covered! Choose from a variety of styles, starting from the comfiest clothes to the most formal ones.

+ 1 free skin
+ 16 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: First Date Clothes
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
It's time for your date! You have to put on your most stylish skin, you really are dressing to impress! Don't worry though, 14 stylish skins are waiting for you in this pack! Pick your favorite skin now and enjoy your first date!

+ 14 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Blocky Mobs HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Want to be a mob with a little style? These mob imposters aren't the real deal but they'll likely bring a smile to your face! Designed with cool textures and colorful pixels to give an interesting cartoon look.


+ 10 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Halloween Aesthetic HD
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Ready to enjoy the Halloween season? Do so as an aesthetic and edgy teen with vibrant fall colors and spooky styles. Great for everyday survival with your friends, roleplays, and seasonal holiday parties!

+ 14 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: SkyBlock 200 Days Challenge
items.creator: KA Studios
items.description:
Take on the new 200 Days Skyblock Challenge! Try to survive on the skyblock island for 200 days and defeat the ender dragon! Explore new floating islands filled with hidden treasures! You can complete this challenge alone or with your friends!

Includes:

- Floating Islands
- Hidden Treasures
- Classic Skyblock
- Multiplayer and singleplayer
- Survival Spawn

By KA Studios

items.title: Halloween Pumpkins
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Dress up for the party very elegantly in these pumpkin costumes! Make a splash on the dance floor or show who's boss at table games.

+ 12 skins (2 free!)
+ Perfect for playing with friends

items.title: K-Pop Style
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Ever wanted to dress like a famous k pop star? This skin pack is all about the best Korean fashion practices. Choose your favorite skin and join the game as a fashionable teen.

+ Teen
+ K Pop
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Halloween Night
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Every year, on a certain day, these monsters wake up from their sleep to scare other players. It is a cursed people, monsters and madmen. All of them are here to bring horror. Which one of them will you choose?

+ Halloween
+ Monsters
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Young Trend Performers
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Have you ever wanted to be a performer? With this skin pack, you would be able to play as young and trendy performers. These skins are full of creativity and empowered to sing, dance and have fun!

+ Anime
+ K-Pop
+ Fashion
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Sky World
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Welcome to Sky World. A floating world high in the sky. Discover the islands, get resources and trade with the villagers of the town. Become a part of this awesome universe!

- An objectives book with dozens of challenges to complete!
- An epic Skyblock Adventure!
- Tons of fun alone or with your friends!
- Dungeons to defeat and monsters to slay
- By Pixelusion & Hylarion

items.title: Spooky Furniture
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
Create your own interactive Halloween town with Spooky Furniture. Haunt and decorate an evil castle, a hidden witches' hut, or your very own mausoleum with furniture that stares, scares, and flushes itself! 


-A ridable broom and pumpkin carriage!
-Mobs that transform at night
-800+ animated models, textures, and variants
-4 Skins
-A creepy Halloween-themed village

items.title: ONE BLOCK SURVIVAL!
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
If skyblock is too easy, try one block! Can you survive the challenge?
Every time the block breaks it's replaced with a new block!

items.title: Miners
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Mining with your friends with the perfect skin. Find diamonds, emeralds, redstone or gold in your vanilla world. And have fun with these skins.

+ 10 different Miners
+ 1 free skin

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Underwater Animals
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Are you a water lover? Dive into the deep ocean and find incredible creatures in the deep sea. And visit the Mariana trench.

+ 10 different animals
+ 1 free skin

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Dragons

items.description:
Play with your friends. Become a dragon and be the fire in your world!

+ 10 different dragons
+ 1 free skin

Created by Mine-North

Put on these PvP outfits and become the warrior you always wanted to be!
